scientific_integrity: A same mathematical model proof and exact arithmetic review only. Smoothness and normal-basis construction credited to Asgarli--Ghioca--Reichstein. Novelty restricted to the net-specific Singer-orbit and rational incidence statements, infinite q+1 degree family, and explicit Klein identification; the classical Klein curve and known twist theory are not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: General counts concern rational-point incidence and the indicated Singer subgroup; full zeta is established only for the characteristic-three quartic instance. No full automorphism-orbit classification for noncoprime cases or independent audit. Possible unindexed prior equivalences remain.
title: Singer-orbit rigidity, finite-projective incidence, and thirteen Klein quartics over \(\mathbb F_3\)
